source_interpretation.conclusion: No demonstrated production defect. A loaded-geometry coefficient-hold diagnostic can isolate a documented Newton approximation, but the primary sources do not establish that the published Daedalus BODE curve used it.

primary_evidence.explicit: The multiple-surface Newton approximation retains circulation and freestream speed/angle dependence while lagging relative surface deflections. Precomputed jig/zero-angle coefficients are a separate stronger approximation.

Equation 132 defines M=-partial r/partial xdot, A=partial r/partial x, B=partial r/partial u. The following paragraph says converged Newton matrices are reused. Output derivatives are defined separately in equation 134.
primary_evidence.limit: The text does not say whether any previously lagged geometry terms were refreshed for the historical BODE executable/drawing. Matrix reuse alone does not override the full-partial definition.

primary_evidence.explicit: Steady stability/control derivatives also reuse the Newton system.
Ak and pointwise circulation are dimensional. For a fixed material sampling matrix S, holding H geometry at fixed Gamma is equivalent to fixed Ak; no extra freestream-speed factor is implied.
primary_evidence.limit: A varying S would require a separate H*dS*Ak term. C16 uses pointwise circulation; this diagnostic does not address modal truncation or weighted tangency.

current_implementation.finding: IterationFields supports lagged Newton setup, but its geometry phase replays jet values too. The structured static matrix uses distinct support/forward-difference assembly and is not a substitute for the full dynamic A.

The local held-field partial is explicitly completed by moving vortex/volume/jet derivatives. The complete circulation rows are restored, and the returned method states full moving induced-field chain rule.
Dynamic linearization uses the completed geometry columns or full-residual fallback; M is separately assembled from physical rate partials.

Coefficient queries have distinct vortex/volume keys; local geometry, physical normals, speed multipliers, engine onset and jet laws are separately visible. This permits a narrow temporary held-coefficient context.
The public freeze_influences option uses undeformed jig geometry and fixed +x direction; it changes the base model and is not a loaded-base derivative-only option.

Retained output fields contain the full moving-field tangent. They cannot be silently reused as output derivatives of a changed held-field policy; the proposed first screen has no recovered aerodynamic outputs.

existing_evidence_and_nonduplication.c16_geometry: 702 complete geometry columns, pointwise 91 Gamma variables, full descriptor size 2215. Saved diagnostics report the full moving induced-field chain, not an omitted geometry term. A direct jet-geometry optimization fallback still uses refined physical field differences.
existing_evidence_and_nonduplication.full_residual_directional_check: At C16 6.7 m/s, the accepted 1 Hz check used 49 full residuals and passed all 12 original two-width comparisons; maximum reported A difference 2.1e-9. It supports assembled-derivative correctness against implemented equations, not historical ASWING parity.
existing_evidence_and_nonduplication.existing_options: K/F (freeze_influences=True) has now been tested separately. Component frozen-influence and moving-geometry tests exist, but no public dynamic option implements the proposed loaded-base coefficient-only hold.
existing_evidence_and_nonduplication.stage_separation: This review is separate from the closed frozen-jig study. No frozen-jig files or production files were edited.

proposed_derivative_contract.name: Loaded-base nonlocal coefficient-geometry hold; all vortex/volume receivers
proposed_derivative_contract.state: Exact accepted C16 loaded state, condition and numerical scales, freeze_influences=False, ground off. q is native nodal position/spatial-rotation columns [0,702). No retrim.
proposed_derivative_contract.held: Only vortex influence coefficients H and volume influence coefficients w at the accepted loaded geometry and baseline wind/PG, for q-only probes; includes CP, force, axis, engine, body, shoulder and point receiver queries actually present.
proposed_derivative_contract.live: Current geometry/frames/normals, local control law, Gamma and Gamma-dot application, explicit speed*w, local/frame motion, structural/gravity/inertia terms, external load transfer and arms, engine position/axis/load law and jet evaluation remain live. Other A columns and all M/B remain original.
proposed_derivative_contract.identity: A_full[:,q] - A_hold[:,q] = R_H*dH/dq + R_w*dw/dq, with downstream live engine/jet onset chains included in R_H and R_w. The difference is the intended signal, not an equality criterion.
proposed_derivative_contract.primary_scope_limit: Holding all H geometry also suppresses within-surface coefficient geometry. It is broader than a strictly cross-surface-only reading of relative deflections; do not name it a proven historical ASWING policy.
proposed_derivative_contract.invariance_limit: Common translation without ground leaves coefficient maps unchanged. Holding tensor components is a specified local derivative policy at this body-frame base, not a generally objective replacement physical law under arbitrary common rotations.
api_plan: Use an isolated IterationFields-compatible context with its capture protocol; fixed_geometry always calls compute so local lifting and volume setup follow each current geometry.

In get, capture base vortex/volume coefficients and replay them by exact known receiver key/order/shape only during q probes. Unknown keys must fail. For jet keys always call compute; never reuse raw IterationFields geometry replay wholesale.
Hold engine onset vortex/volume coefficients consistently while recomputing engine motion, axis, load and jet fields. Do not hold induced velocity H*Gamma0, total flow, or evaluated engine/jet loads.

Disable full-load cache reuse (_tangent_loads) inside the partial context. Restore prior iteration_fields, tangent_influences and _tangent_loads in finally; clear aero_key on entry/exit. Preserve existing field budgets and clipping/branch guards.
Do not drop all q columns, copy the static structured matrix wholesale, alter current sampling coordinates, or reuse full output-field tangents for this changed policy.
